# proxmox_node_termproxy (Data Source)

Requests a node terminal proxy ticket from `/nodes/{node}/termproxy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_termproxy" "t" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Optional

- `command` (String)
- `command_opts` (String)

### Read-Only

- `port` (String)
- `proxy` (String)
- `result` (String)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `upid` (String)
- `user` (String)
